2. It is contended in the application that inadvertently and out of bonafide mistake the learned Advocate of the appellant-applicants has preferred the instant First Appeal under Order XLI, Rule I of the Code of Civil Procedure challenging the judgment and decree dated 30.5.2004 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Gazipur in Title Suit No.82 of 2001 instead of First Miscellaneous Appeal: It is further contended that at the time of hearing of the appeal the 

 learned Advocate for the appellants for the first time upon hearing the learned Advocate for the respondents have realized that he has mistakenly preferred First Appeal instead of First Miscellaneous Appeal against the impugned judgment and decree dated 30.5.2004 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Gazipur in Title Suit No.82 of 2001. It is further contended that the instant First Appeal was filed because of bonafide mistake of the learned Advocate for the appellant-applicants and that, the appellant-applicants have no latches or negligence in the matter and unless the First Appeal is treated as a First Miscellaneous Appeal the appellant-applicants will suffer irreparable loss and injury.

 the appellants for the first time upon hearing the learned Advocate for the respondents having realized that he mistakenly preferred the instant First Appeal instead of First Miscellaneous Appeal against the impugned judgment and decree dated 30.5.2004 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, Court, Gazipur in Title Suit No.82 of 2001.
